figuras.descricao_fonte: Continuing from Figure 2. In Figure 2, Ebbinghaus ran a series of 92 tests. In each test, he gave the subject 13 random syllables and let the subject memorize them. Then he gave the subject another 13 random syllables, and so on, for 8 times in total. Each time, he noted down how many seconds it took for the subject to memorize the 13 syllables.
